reviewFindings: The old single pre-scan HEAD/cleanliness observation could be stale by the time direct skill discovery finished. The new pre/post STABLE_CLEAN gate prevents that state from being promoted into current provenance.

The previous emitted capability boundary said probeExecutedByThisArtifact=false even in output produced by an executing probe. The source now distinguishes source existence from report-time process execution while leaving tested/runtime states false.

The existing DOM specimen gained one materially new provenance state, UNSTABLE SNAPSHOT, while preserving radio semantics, roving keyboard navigation, >=48px targets, non-color tokens, one live detail surface, and reduced-motion behavior.

Fresh code review found one independent next wound: discover_skills still permits an unreadable or malformed-UTF-8 SKILL.md to raise during sha/title extraction instead of converting that file into a bounded discoveryErrors entry. This does not negate the bounded snapshot-stability source claim, but it must remain open rather than being painted green.
